why: ja tier-1 normalisation is one pure idempotent function with a named dash-fold set

cases.note: halfwidth, U+2015 and the real chōonpu all collapse to one string; 珈琲 does not
mora, not characters: がっこう is four — the sokuon IS a mora
small ya/yu/yo ride the preceding mora: きょう is two
iteration marks expand, and expanding twice changes nothing

REGRESSION 2026-09-11 (normalise.test.ts): a single pass folded the leading dash, then met 一 whose LEFT was already ー but whose RIGHT was still an unfolded -, so 一 survived and the answer came out ー一ー; normalising that again gave ーーー. The fold now runs to a fixed point.

REGRESSION 2026-09-11 (normalise.test.ts): the mirror case — fold 一 first and it survives, because its left is the hiragana iteration mark; expand the mark and the left becomes ア, so the next pass folds it after all. Neither ordering is stable; the fixed point is.

REGRESSION 2026-09-11 (normalise.test.ts): tier 1 in the ja pack stripped whitespace AFTER the ja fold, so ヾ saw a space on its left, did not expand, and only repeated the が once the space was gone on a second pass. NFKC can itself create whitespace (U+309B, U+309C among 52 code points), so reordering cannot fix it — tier1Normalise runs to a fixed point too.
